environment.description: Same container image deployed behind an AWS Lambda Function URL (streaming response mode enabled for WebSocket-like behavior). The Function URL resource policy has aws:PrincipalOrgID condition restricting invoke to the organization. The Lambda Function URL auth_type is set to AWS_IAM. The function's resource-based policy does NOT include a lambda:FunctionUrlAllowPublicAccess permission statement. CloudTrail data events are enabled on the Lambda function for audit. Note: the code's CheckOrigin permissiveness and lack of session validation remain as-is in the source, but the Lambda Function URL IAM auth requirement means the TLS handshake completes but the HTTP request (including WebSocket upgrade) requires a valid SigV4 signature in the Authorization header — unsigned requests receive a 403 {"Message":"Forbidden"} before the request reaches the Lambda handler code.
